archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-parser
archetypes.rationale: Changed parser-visible architectural guideline entries and section placement.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review ARCHITECTURAL_GUIDELINES.md for parser-visible heading and bullet shape. Verify the seven new entries remain judgment-only, keep the G-Py-9 and G-Cfg-2 gaps, preserve existing entries, and sit in the requested sections. Check for markdownlint traps such as heading-level jumps and code-span whitespace. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
